decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - In view of the extremely high numbers of new residential units and limited off-street car parking facilities there is concern that the scheme will result in undue levels of car parking within Bedford Park Conservation Area at times when traffic controls are not in operation.

Condition : 2 - Warple Way acts as an important footpath between Bedford Park and East Acton. The Council is concerned that crime levels should be reduced on this footpath and requests that appropriate measures to reduce crime in this location should be taken in relation to the new development.
description: Conversion and alterations to existing buildings; erection of new buildings ranging between 2 and 8 storeys to provide 589 residential units and 293 parking spaces; provision of a school building; pedestrian and vehicular access and associated works (Outline Application)
